summary: Removed all Tauri/desktop support from the Gizmo repo: deleted src-tauri, the sidecar build script, desktop.ts wrapper, WindowControls and NativeWorkspacePicker components, and all @tauri-apps/* dependencies; stripped desktop branches from UI and server code; renamed TAURI_DEV_HOST→GIZMO_DEV_HOST and TAURI_ENV_DEBUG→GIZMO_DEBUG_BUILD since they carried non-desktop functionality. Committed as c071310 (84 files, +505/-5309), pushed to origin/pi-web, verified with 447 passing tests and a live web server on the new build. Also pushed 2 pre-existing unpushed commits in gizmo-skills-registry after checking both registries.
decisions: Gizmo is now web-only; Tauri/desktop path is permanently removed and noted in agent memory so it isn't suggested again
Renamed TAURI_DEV_HOST → GIZMO_DEV_HOST rather than dropping it because it served the real purpose of exposing the dev server on a LAN/Tailscale host
Renamed TAURI_ENV_DEBUG → GIZMO_DEBUG_BUILD for the same reason (controlled unminified debug builds)
Where code branched on isDesktop() for native affordances (workspace picker, transcript export), the browser fallback path (WorkspaceBrowser, plain download) is now the only path
docs/extensions.md and README.md were rewritten to describe the web server in place of the desktop build
